description: An interactive drag-and-label tool for Grade 7 Science (NCERT Chapter 3, Activity 3.4). A large, clear illustration of an incandescent lamp is displayed in the centre, showing the internal structure: transparent glass bulb dome at top, thin coiled filament inside, two thick support wires holding the filament, cylindrical metal case at the base (terminal 1), small circular metal tip at the very bottom (terminal 2), and insulator material between metal case and metal tip. Six floating label cards are arranged around the diagram: Glass Bulb, Filament, Support Wires, Metal Case (Terminal 1), Metal Tip (Terminal 2), Insulator. Students drag each label to the correct target zone on the lamp. Green highlight and checkmark for correct placement. Red shake and snap-back for incorrect. Toggle-able hint system shows brief descriptions. Amber theme colour. Indian school educational context. Responsive touch-friendly drag-and-drop. Score tracking with completion celebration.
subject: Science
chapter: Chapter 3 - Electricity: Circuits and their Components

additionalProps.description: Tool-specific dynamic data for customising the labeling activity

labels.description: Array of label objects for the parts to identify

hint.description: Hint description shown when hints are enabled

default.hint: The transparent dome at the top that protects the filament
The thin coiled wire that glows white-hot to produce light
Two thick wires that hold the filament in place
The cylindrical metal base — one of two electrical terminals
The small circular contact at the very bottom — the other terminal
Material between the metal case and metal tip preventing short circuit

showHints.description: Whether hints are shown by default

celebrationMessage.default: 🎉 Excellent! You labelled all parts correctly!

examples.description: Default - all 6 parts with hints ON

examples.description: Only 3 key parts for younger students

labels.hint: The round glass part at the top
The wire that glows and gives light
The metal part at the bottom

teaching_notes: Activate DURING Activity 3.4 when students are examining the lamp structure. Say: 'You've seen the labeled diagram — now label the parts yourself!' Start with hints ON. If student gets all correct, challenge them to try with hints OFF. Key teaching: the insulator separates the two terminals to prevent a short circuit.
instructions_for_student: Drag each label to the correct part of the incandescent lamp! Start from the top (glass bulb) and work your way down. Use hints if you're stuck!
learning_objectives: Identify the six key parts of an incandescent lamp
Understand the function of the filament in producing light
Know that a lamp has two terminals (metal case and metal tip)
Understand the role of the insulator in preventing short circuits
Learn how support wires hold the filament in position
